name: vice-suite
description: ViceSuite — market intelligence, education, and non-custodial trading.

scripts.build: bun run build:site && bun run build:terminal
scripts.test:catalog: cd vice-terminal && bun test src/lib/hl/markets.test.js src/lib/hl/liveMarketUpdates.test.js src/lib/hl/accountIdentity.test.js src/lib/hl/candleMerge.test.js
scripts.test:contract: bun run test:backend && cd vice-terminal && bun test src/lib/execution/identityBoundary.test.js src/lib/execution/venueFormat.test.js src/lib/execution/expiry.test.js
scripts.test:chaos: cd vice-terminal && bun test src/lib/execution/commandIdentity.test.js src/lib/execution/retryPolicy.test.js src/lib/execution/commandJournal.test.js src/lib/execution/reconcileCloid.test.js src/lib/execution/localExecutionPartialAcceptance.test.js src/lib/execution/reconciliationCompleteness.test.js src/lib/execution/algoCancellation.test.js src/lib/hl/snapshotCoordinator.test.js
scripts.test:revenue: cd vice-terminal && bun test src/lib/execution/revenueConfig.test.js src/lib/execution/agentVault.test.js src/lib/execution/revenueSurface.test.js
scripts.test:load: cd vice-terminal && bun test src/lib/execution/commandIdentity.test.js src/lib/execution/latencyGates.test.js src/lib/execution/responseOutcome.test.js src/lib/chart/overlayScheduling.test.js
scripts.test:pwa: bun test vice-terminal/src/lib/pwa.test.js vice-terminal/scripts/pwa-prod.test.mjs && cd vice-terminal && bun test scripts/pwa-artifact.test.mjs
scripts.test:widgets: bun test scripts/widget-catalog.test.mjs scripts/hub-route.test.mjs scripts/hub-persistence.test.mjs vice-terminal/src/lib/suite/widgets.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/marketMovers.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/nativeNotes.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/sessionClocks.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/candleCountdown.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/chartReadOnlySurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeWatchlistPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeMarketMoversPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeSuiteLinksPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeNotesPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeSessionClocksPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativeCandleCountdownPortSurface.test.js vice-terminal/src/lib/components/nativePriceChartPortSurface.test.js && bun scripts/widget-catalog.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:funded: bun test scripts/e2e-gate.test.mjs && VICE_E2E_FUNDED=1 bun scripts/e2e-gate.mjs --funded
scripts.check: bun run preflight && bun run typecheck && bun run test:svelte && bun run test:frontend && bun run test:backend && bun run build
